provenance.description: Extract structured listing data from a supplied document batch and produce a bounded comparison analysis.

intent.outcome: Parse the supplied listing document batch into a structured dataset (address, price, features, condition, source page) and produce a comparison analysis with per-field confidence notes; deliverable is a dataset file plus a summary report. No external publication.
non_goals: No publication to any external platform

sufficiency.rationale: Inputs, extraction schema, deliverable form, privacy boundary, and confidence convention are explicit and testable.

criteria: Every source document appears in the dataset with a source page reference
Extraction schema followed; missing fields marked unknown, never invented
Confidence note per extracted field; summary report produced
No external emission or network access performed

control.cancel_policy: no re-issue on timeout; classify INDETERMINATE; reconcile before retry
